lines.en: Good morning! Fresh apples, picked at dawn. Two coins a basket.
lines.text: Prait lér! Clanreuque cécassi, lauvimete ké maumu. Daume vratri za guiangésse.

lines.en: Two coins? They look a little bruised to me.
lines.text: Daume vratrisi? Kon cheau za blait bradanchin vé pè.

lines.en: Bruised? Those are freckles. Apples have freckles too.
lines.text: Pranségete? Meu jé douron. Cécassi mio nazbransi flait.

lines.en: Then the freckles cost one coin, and the apples another.
lines.text: Lia za nazbransi rafeve rausse vratri, zi za cécassi diait.

lines.en: Ah, you are a hard woman. One and a half, and I add a pear.
lines.text: Ah, bé jé za vaplou réque. Rausse zi za aijon, zi pè rissou za zaru.

lines.en: One coin and the pear, and I come back tomorrow.
lines.text: Rausse vratri zi za zaru, zi pè preau quait piait.

lines.en: Every day you come back, and every day I lose money. Fine. One coin.
lines.text: Miait creur bé preau quait, zi miait creur pè nér vouque. Frait. Rausse vratri.

lines.en: You never lose money. Thank you, old friend.
lines.text: Bé zou zér nér teu vouque. Mérsil bé, bleune lanziait.

lines.en: How much for the long blade on the wall?
lines.text: Nausse vrar jou za dréque tilpra ké za vaintute?

lines.en: Forty silver. Good steel, folded twelve times.
lines.text: Pouga plér. Prait vènan, ciquuvete méceau jeuqui.

lines.en: Forty? I could buy a horse for forty.
lines.text: Pouga? Pè bréle vépran za oubru jou pouga.

lines.en: Then ride the horse into battle and see how it cuts.
lines.text: Lia clait za oubru vé tauvi zi cleu nausse fè aillait.

lines.en: Twenty-five. The hilt is plain and the guard is too short.
lines.text: Trougi. Za voncoiguait jé reuja zi za pauvi jé flait claur.

lines.en: The guard is exactly as long as it should be. Thirty-five, not one coin less.
lines.text: Za pauvi jé biatalman trère dréque trère fè vousse jé. Télove, zou rausse vratri frapèllon teu.

lines.en: Thirty, and I tell every soldier in the camp where I bought it.
lines.text: Chèreau, zi pè quèsson miait getva ké za cifrais bou pè vépranvete fè.

lines.en: ...Thirty-two. And you sharpen it here, not at that thief across the square.
lines.text: ... Soujin. Zi bé vumfra fè bou, zou ké meu dèpan naume za ronqué teu.

lines.en: Deal.
lines.text: Punsa.

lines.en: We need a room for two nights, and a stall for the mule.
lines.text: Ju léme za vreau jou daume léssi, zi za détser jou za mispissauque.

lines.en: Room is six a night. The mule is two, he eats more than you.
lines.text: Vreau jé raume za lésse. Za mispissauque jé daume, fè quéle bélon cauve bé.

lines.en: That is true, he does.
lines.text: Meu jé roin, fè mio.

lines.en: Could we do ten for everything if we help in the kitchen?
lines.text: Bréle ju mio dréve jou treau brésse ju drausse ké za vrule?

lines.en: Can you cook?
lines.text: Quiait bé gimraute?

lines.en: He can burn water. I can cook.
lines.text: Fè quiait clureau proule. Pè quiait gimraute.

lines.en: Then she works, and you carry wood. Ten for everything.
lines.text: Lia fè dége, zi bé chivoi creau. Dréve jou treau.

lines.en: Fair enough. Where do I find the axe?
lines.text: Réle lansin. Bou mio pè gueuque za boilan?

lines.en: My cow for your two goats and the cart.
lines.text: Leu mépreau jou zan daume lopleusi zi za aibrou.

lines.en: Your cow is old. The cart is almost new.
lines.text: Zan mépreau jé bleune. Za aibrou jé naton déque.

lines.en: She is old, but she still gives milk every morning. Your goats eat my fence.
lines.text: Fè jé bleune, guait fè glait feau soué miait lér. Zan lopleusi quéle leu tréri.

lines.en: Hmm. The cart stays with me. Cow for the two goats and a sack of grain.
lines.text: Hmm. Za aibrou reuque kou pè. Mépreau jou za daume lopleusi zi za julé dè flumflé.

lines.en: Two sacks.
lines.text: Daume julési.

lines.en: One sack, and I lend you the cart at harvest.
lines.text: Rausse julé, zi pè itait bé za aibrou ké jeuma.

lines.en: All right. Shake on it.
lines.text: Zédou raur. Veuté ké fè.

lines.en: We pay ten silver a man for the week. Food included.
lines.text: Ju daque drévete plér za céque jou za alusse. Franton mauquete.

lines.en: Ten? The road to the north is full of raiders.
lines.text: Dréve? Za taul vé za désse jé tréti dè mureuvausi.

lines.en: Last month the lord paid twenty.
lines.text: Geau nouifré za preugar daquete quége.

lines.en: Last month the lord lost half his men. I am not him.
lines.text: Geau nouifré za preugar nérete aijon pon eurèsi. Pè jé zou fè teu.

lines.en: Fifteen, and we keep whatever we take from the raiders.
lines.text: Liclou, zi ju dieau freau ju glé dè za mureuvausi.

lines.en: Twelve, you keep the weapons, the coin goes to the village.
lines.text: Méceau, bé dieau za vourési, za vratri téme vé za mafreu.

lines.en: Take it. The village fed us last winter.
lines.text: Glé fè. Za mafreu souditete ju geau rauveul.

lines.en: Twelve then. But the food better be warm.
lines.text: Méceau lia. Guait za franton féque jé rèvait.

lines.en: Do you have anything for a cough? My son has been coughing for three days.
lines.text: Bé mio résse jou za ligé? Leu rèssa mio zagete ligédan jou croume creuri.

lines.en: Honey, thyme and a little pine resin. Boil it, let him breathe the steam.
lines.text: Bratran, rumjeu zi za blait aidiait diédu. Raupais fè, nélete fè tansouque za quémésse.

lines.en: How much is it?
lines.text: Nausse vrar jé fè?

lines.en: Three coins, but bring the jar back and the next one is two.
lines.text: Croume vratrisi, guait draudant za lauchais quait zi za reule rausse jé daume.

lines.en: I only have two now.
lines.text: Pè déne mio daume poui.

lines.en: Then pay me two now and the rest when he is well.
lines.text: Lia daque pè daume poui zi za soino seuque fè jé féque.

lines.en: Thank you. Really.
lines.text: Mérsil bé. Cevmant.

lines.en: Forty winters ago we held the bridge at the black river. Nine of us. Nine.
lines.text: Pouga rauveuli tréton ju zauvete za trér ké za frir gaugi. Seune dè ju. Seune.

lines.en: Against how many?
lines.text: Grait nausse leule?

lines.en: Nobody counted. When the sun came up, the river was the colour of wine.
lines.text: Dauve frogete. Seuque za rassé prauvete lauge, za frir jé za lémsesse dè zait.

lines.en: Every year the river gets redder and the enemy gets bigger.
lines.text: Miait zime za frir brour mécon zi za truve brour crésson.

lines.en: Every year my knees get older, so the story must get stronger.
lines.text: Miait zime leu fauquusi brour bleunon, lia za madé fréte brour voutièllon.

lines.en: And then what happened?
lines.text: Zi lia lan tontauvete?

lines.en: Then the rain came. Three days of rain. And on the fourth morning, they were gone.
lines.text: Lia za drile prauvete. Croume creuri dè drile. Zi ké za lér freve, kon jé témete.

lines.en: Just gone?
lines.text: Cleau témete?

lines.en: Just gone. Sometimes the river decides who wins, boy. Not the sword.
lines.text: Cleau témete. Greume za frir cénmansi vrou chétrou, teusse. zou za nopri teu.

lines.en: In the forest beyond the mill, there is a stone that sings at night.
lines.text: Ké za crouron siait za crufime, bou jé za léssa meu reclé ké lésse.

lines.en: Stones cannot sing.
lines.text: Léssasi quiait zou reclé teu.

lines.en: This one can. Low and slow, like a mother humming to her baby.
lines.text: Meu rausse quiait. Néve zi flaul, gueur za vouguio drousmadan vé fè rouito.

lines.en: Did you hear it?
lines.text: Bé viait fè?

lines.en: Once. I was younger than you. I followed the song until the trees were black around me.
lines.text: Monser. Pè jé bloron cauve bé. Pè plalgavete za quuge téve za glausi jé gaugi ruque pè.

lines.en: And then?
lines.text: Zi lia?

lines.en: Then your grandfather found me, asleep against the stone, with frost in my hair.
lines.text: Lia zan étru gueuquete pè, tidait grait za léssa, kou bécou ké leu feussi.

lines.en: Was the stone angry?
lines.text: Jé za léssa druran?

lines.en: No, little one. I think it was lonely. Now go to sleep.
lines.text: Nèk, blait rausse. Pè loume fè jé quecloman. Poui téme v'udro.

lines.en: Did I ever tell you about the goat that crossed the mountains with me?
lines.text: Pè zér quèsson bé crir za lopleu meu lérquivete za vravi kou pè?

lines.en: Only twice this week.
lines.text: Déne néque meu alusse.

lines.en: Then this is the third time. She ate my map on the first day.
lines.text: Lia meu jé za jeuque pouque. Fè quéle leu zéte ké za louque creur.

lines.en: So how did you find the pass?
lines.text: Lia nausse bé gueuque za pombro?

lines.en: I followed the goat. She knew the way better than the map.
lines.text: Pè plalgavete za lopleu. Fè vrérete za noume fécon cauve za zéte.

lines.en: And where is this clever goat now?
lines.text: Zi bou jé meu lopleu nicron poui?

lines.en: She married a shepherd on the other side. I came back alone.
lines.text: Fè trivainvete za gorté ké za péve trir. Pè prauvete quait mèvi.

lines.en: Married!
lines.text: Mige!

lines.en: In her way. She never looked back, not even once.
lines.text: Ké fè noume. Fè zou zér chauvete teu quait, zou gléle monser teu.

lines.en: You never talk about the siege.
lines.text: Bé zou zér lonva teu crir za népri.

lines.en: There is not much to say. We were hungry, then we were very hungry.
lines.text: Bou jé zou vrar vé greur teu. Ju jé muglale, lia ju jé méve muglale.

lines.en: Your brother was there.
lines.text: Zan liaru jé bou.

lines.en: He was. He gave me his bread on the last night. Said he was not hungry.
lines.text: Fè jé. Fè fauvete pè pon plalait ké za geau lésse. Greurete fè jé zou muglale teu.

lines.en: Was he?
lines.text: Jé fè?

lines.en: He was the hungriest man I ever knew. ...He did not see the morning.
lines.text: Fè jé za muglalon céque pè zér vrérete.... Fè zou cleu teu za lér.

lines.en: I am sorry.
lines.text: Pè jé dézou.

lines.en: Do not be. Every morning I see is a little bit his.
lines.text: Mio zou jé teu. Lér miait pè cleu jé za blait quainquer pon.

lines.en: We went in through the old drain. Water up to our knees, rats everywhere.
lines.text: Ju témete ké vrine za bleune drachésse. Proule lauge vé pon fauquusi, gauponsi grile.

lines.en: Rats. Of course there were rats.
lines.text: Gauponsi. Dè brecra bou jé gauponsi.

lines.en: At the end, a gate. Rusted shut. Torven pulled so hard his face went purple.
lines.text: Ké za tiait, za sarfré. Épiavete quènete. Fraussais viabivete lia réque pon quieau témete rèma.

lines.en: Did it open?
lines.text: Mio fè tiébla?

lines.en: No. The wall next to it fell down instead.
lines.text: Nèk. Za vaintute reule vé fè maunete chaune pauplo.

lines.en: That sounds like Torven.
lines.text: Meu lieau gueur Vabia.

lines.en: So we walked into the cellar through the hole, and the guards were asleep on the wine barrels.
lines.text: Lia ju prégete vé za clouprait vrine za vraque, zi za pauvisi jé tidait ké za zait deurquisi.

lines.en: And the key?
lines.text: Zi za biédu?

lines.en: Around the fat one's neck. He never woke up.
lines.text: Ruque za jièrait rausse poge. Fè zou zér sauvrirete teu lauge.

lines.en: Stop. Nobody passes the gate after dark.
lines.text: Ladé. Dauve mészi za sarfré guéte guiait.

lines.en: We live on the other side! Our children are inside.
lines.text: Ju veuge ké za péve trir! Pon pronfainsi jé bleque.

lines.en: Rules are rules. Come back at dawn.
lines.text: Dèssainsi jé dèssainsi. Preau quait ké maumu.

lines.en: Our son is six years old and alone in that house!
lines.text: Pon rèssa jé raume zimi bleune zi mèvi ké meu crale!

lines.en: And if I open this gate for you, I open it for everyone.
lines.text: Zi brésse pè tiébla meu sarfré jou bé, pè tiébla fè jou zouque.

lines.en: Then open it for everyone! Who is out there? Nobody!
lines.text: Lia tiébla fè jou zouque! Vrou jé plauve bou? Dauve!

lines.en: ...Fine. Quickly. And if the captain asks, you climbed the wall.
lines.text: ... Frait. Brér. Zi brésse za gleu gloume, bé vèrivete za vaintute.

lines.en: Thank you. Thank you.
lines.text: Mérsil bé. Mérsil bé.

lines.en: Father left the mill to me. Everyone knows it.
lines.text: Auflond zèvete za crufime vé pè. Zouque vrér fè.

lines.en: Father left the mill to both of us, and you know it.
lines.text: Auflond zèvete za crufime vé prère dè ju, zi bé vrér fè.

lines.en: You were gone for six years! Six years, and now you want half?
lines.text: Bé jé témete jou raume zimi! Raume zimi, zi poui bé préne aijon?

lines.en: I was gone because he sent me away! To pay his debts!
lines.text: Pè jé témete groque fè blourete pè chume! Vé daque pon pluti!

lines.en: Enough. Both of you, sit down.
lines.text: Lansin. Crecrage dè bé, vrute chaune.

lines.en: Mother, he...
lines.text: Vouguio, fè...

lines.en: I said sit. Your father wanted you to work it together. Not to fight over it like dogs.
lines.text: Pè greurete vrute. Zan auflond prénete bé vé dége fè tauge. zou vé guésse teu cége fè gueur peussosi.

lines.en: ...I did not come back for the mill. I came back for you.
lines.text: ... Pè zou preau teu quait jou za crufime. Pè prauvete quait jou bé.

lines.en: I know, son. I know.
lines.text: Pè vrér, rèssa. Pè vrér.

lines.en: Your stall pays the market tax. Five silver.
lines.text: Zan détser daque za cloute cètais. Guule plér.

lines.en: I paid last week.
lines.text: Pè daquete geau alusse.

lines.en: This is this week.
lines.text: Meu jé meu alusse.

lines.en: The tax is every month, not every week. Everyone knows that.
lines.text: Za cètais jé miait nouifré, zou miait alusse teu. Zouque vrér meu.

lines.en: The lord changed it.
lines.text: Za preugar ziégèvete fè.

lines.en: Then show me the paper with his seal.
lines.text: Lia jiait pè za gaque kou pon napeu.

lines.en: I do not have the paper here.
lines.text: Pè zou mio teu za gaque bou.

lines.en: Then come back with the paper, and I pay. Not before.
lines.text: Lia prauvete quait kou za gaque, zi pè daque. zou fove teu.

lines.en: That was my bread. I put it on the barrel.
lines.text: Meu jé leu plalait. Pè crérete fè ké za deurqui.

lines.en: There was no name on it.
lines.text: Bou jé nèk césse ké fè.

lines.en: It does not need a name! It was on MY barrel!
lines.text: Fè zou léme teu za césse! Fè jé ké leu deurqui!

lines.en: There is more bread. Stop shouting in my kitchen.
lines.text: Bou jé bélon plalait. Ladé étoin ké leu vrule.

lines.en: See? More bread. Go get some.
lines.text: Cleu? Bélon plalait. Téme brour jieau.

lines.en: I do not want more bread, I want MY bread!
lines.text: Pè zou préne teu bélon plalait, pè préne leu plalait!

lines.en: Quiet! Both of you, outside. Now.
lines.text: Mévoué! Crecrage dè bé, deume. Poui.

lines.en: Every night the same war. Over bread.
lines.text: Miait lésse za quère chontron. Cége plalait.

lines.en: Morning. The wind is cold today.
lines.text: Léran. Za létran jé flaur roubrige.

lines.en: It came from the mountains last night. My door was shaking.
lines.text: Fè prauvete dè za vravi geau lésse. Leu veului jé veutédan.

lines.en: Snow before the end of the month, I think.
lines.text: Blébeu fove za tiait dè za nouifré, pè loume.

lines.en: My knee says the same. It always knows.
lines.text: Leu fauquu greur za quère. Fè dreute vrér.

lines.en: Better than any priest.
lines.text: Fécon cauve pleuge dreussa.

lines.en: Are you going to the market?
lines.text: Jé bé téman vé za cloute?

lines.en: Later. I need wool, and maybe some onions.
lines.text: Guimpa. Pè léme fèllait, zi déssi jieau aissonsi.

lines.en: Ask for Berta. She has the good onions this year.
lines.text: Gloume jou Cropleu. Fè mio za prait aissonsi meu zime.

lines.en: Quiet night.
lines.text: Lésse mévoué.

lines.en: Too quiet. I like a little noise. A dog, a drunk, something.
lines.text: Flait mévoué. Pè gueur za blait zigran. Za peusso, za tècar, béme.

lines.en: You want a drunk? Wait until the tavern closes.
lines.text: Bé préne za tècar? Branlan téve za traugi drimamait.

lines.en: True. How is your wife?
lines.text: Roin. Nausse jé zan ziénou?

lines.en: Tired. The baby does not sleep. So nobody sleeps.
lines.text: Praclissete. Za rouito zou udro teu. Lia udrosi dauve.

lines.en: Mine was the same. It gets better after the first teeth.
lines.text: Leu jé za quère. Fè brour fécon guéte za louque vuveu.

lines.en: I hope so. I fell asleep standing yesterday.
lines.text: Pè sieau lia. Pè maunete tidait quéssondan fuque.

lines.en: Standing? That is a soldier.
lines.text: Quéssondan? Meu jé za getva.

lines.en: Wash your hands before you touch the bread.
lines.text: Chéceau zan guussi fove bé pocreau za plalait.

lines.en: They are clean.
lines.text: Kon jé flainviou.

lines.en: They are the colour of the garden.
lines.text: Kon jé za lémsesse dè za lauque.

lines.en: It is good dirt.
lines.text: Fè jé prait lipra.

lines.en: Good dirt goes in the garden, not on the table.
lines.text: Prait lipra téme ké za lauque, zou ké za brèda teu.

lines.en: How was the river today?
lines.text: Nausse jé za frir flaur?

lines.en: I saw a fish as long as my arm!
lines.text: Pè sachérete za zasse trère dréque trère leu rijiait!

lines.en: As long as your arm, or as long as my arm?
lines.text: Trère dréque trère zan rijiait, queve trère dréque trère leu rijiait?

lines.en: As long as your arm. Almost.
lines.text: Trère dréque trère zan rijiait. Naton.

lines.en: How far to the next village?
lines.text: Nausse céte vé za reule mafreu?

lines.en: Half a day if the road is dry.
lines.text: Aijon za creur brésse za taul jé voin.

lines.en: It is never dry.
lines.text: Fè jé zou zér voin teu.

lines.en: Then a full day.
lines.text: Lia za creur tréti.

lines.en: Do they have an inn?
lines.text: Kon mio za caudoi?

lines.en: They have a barn and a woman who makes very good soup.
lines.text: Kon mio za cozti zi za vaplou vrou tége méve prait chèsson.

lines.en: That is better than most inns.
lines.text: Meu jé prèllon cauve zévon lounuico.

lines.en: Then we walk for the soup.
lines.text: Lia ju prége jou za chèsson.

lines.en: Nets are full of weed again.
lines.text: Vévi jé tréti dè turgru zeute.

lines.en: The storm pushed it in. Two more days, it goes out again.
lines.text: Za tege vaunièvete fè ké. Daume bélon creuri, fè téme plauve zeute.

lines.en: Can I come on the boat tomorrow?
lines.text: Quiait pè preau ké za péque piait?

lines.en: If your mother says yes.
lines.text: Brésse zan vouguio greur vèl.

lines.en: His mother says he can clean the fish today, then we see.
lines.text: Pon vouguio greur fè quiait flainviou za zasse flaur, lia ju cleu.

lines.en: Every day the fish.
lines.text: Miait creur za zasse.

lines.en: Every day the fish for all of us, boy. Welcome to the sea.
lines.text: Miait creur za zasse jou frisse dè ju, teusse. Lausse vé za bralan.

lines.en: And tell your father his supper is getting cold.
lines.text: Zi quèsson zan auflond pon broucra jé brouran roubrige.

lines.en: I bet you a coin I can hit the crow on that post.
lines.text: Pè lèré bé za vratri pè quiait nouissin za cracmé ké meu quur.

lines.en: You cannot hit the post.
lines.text: Bé quiait zou nouissin teu za quur.

lines.en: He hit a post once. By accident.
lines.text: Fè nouissainvete za quur monser. Clige bér.

lines.en: Watch and learn.
lines.text: Sougué zi louda.

lines.en: The crow is laughing at you.
lines.text: Za cracmé j'ivieudan ké bé.

lines.en: Pay up.
lines.text: Daque lauge.

lines.en: The wind moved it. The wind.
lines.text: Za létran quissete fè. Za létran.

lines.en: What is in the pot today?
lines.text: Lan jé ké za nélole flaur?

lines.en: Soup.
lines.text: Chèsson.

lines.en: What kind of soup?
lines.text: Lan quusse dè chèsson?

lines.en: The kind that is hot and wet. Do you want it or not?
lines.text: Za quusse meu jé peme zi fiveu. Bé préne fè queve zou teu?

lines.en: Yesterday it was also hot and wet, and it tasted like boots.
lines.text: Fuque fè jé vaume peme zi fiveu, zi fè bièvete gueur panchauri.

lines.en: Yesterday you cleaned the boots in my water bucket.
lines.text: Fuque bé flainviouvete za panchauri ké leu proule éssile.

lines.en: ...Ah. I will eat the soup.
lines.text: ... Ah. Pè mio quéle za chèsson.

lines.en: I brought some bread. And a little honey.
lines.text: Pè drauvete jieau plalait. Zi za blait bratran.

lines.en: You did not have to.
lines.text: Bé zou mio teu vé.

lines.en: I know. Have you eaten today?
lines.text: Pè vrér. Mio bé quéle flaur?

lines.en: I made two bowls this morning. Out of habit. Two bowls.
lines.text: Pè tégete daume prér meu lér. Plauve dè déloule. Daume prér.

lines.en: Then I will eat the other one with you.
